name: Anja Baumgartner
bio:
Anja Baumgartner's motorsport journey began with a childhood fascination for engineering and a deep-seated love for speed. She pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics, and quickly found her way into the world of racing. Starting as a junior engineer, Anja tirelessly worked her way up, proving her mettle through exceptional problem-solving skills and a keen eye for detail. Her ability to translate complex technical data into actionable strategies has earned her a reputation as a rising star. 

As Technical Director for ROWE Racing, Anja takes a holistic approach, emphasizing collaboration and data-driven decision-making. She believes in empowering her team to challenge conventional thinking and embrace innovation. Her visionary leadership is characterized by a relentless pursuit of perfection and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of motorsport technology. Anja's ability to anticipate future trends and adapt to evolving challenges makes her a formidable force in the paddock.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often tied back in a practical ponytail during races.
physical.description: Anja is of average height with a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor that commands respect.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on listening to classical music in her office to foster concentration.
